about:
The one bound's test vectors (te_core.formalism's `bound`, and `at` under reading A), which the console's rho.ts
runs. null is unmeasured (a term, the max, or ρ where no kind is measured); JSON has no infinity, so ∞ is "inf".

adapter.decoder: none: E stores the grown block's tensors (the model format)
adapter.delta: the trace's update cut, theta' as the step reads it (the grown block's four tensors)

adapter-live.decoder: none: the dead entries are zero
adapter-live.delta: stated: an E of the live entries alone (w_gate's and w_up's 8 live rows and w_down's 8 live columns at bf16, mlp_norm at fp32; wildcard's 05:46Z LOOPHOLE)

dense.decoder: none: E stores the tensors (the full format)
dense.delta: the trace's update cut, theta' as the step reads it (every block tensor)

lora.decoder: W + B A for the 14 matrices, 425984 fp32 multiply-adds at F32Fma_v4's gates each
lora.delta: the trace's update cut, the factors and gains as the step reads them

rests_on.decoding: assumption (D): a block reading the update code runs the whole decoder, so it holds at most c - d gates; with A1 (reading A) and the token kind's witness family
rests_on.fresh_products: theorem for this circuit: the Loomis-Whitney cap on a block's MACs of products of two fresh operands, amortized over the partition (te_core.io_bound), given the standard algorithm and the widths the step passes
rests_on.token: assumption (A1, reading A) with its witness family, closed under unions: the runs of one traced token's path in segments (the trace's entries) and the matrix-product tiles of the record's op log, weight-gradient tiles among them (te_core.tiles); a block's work is a union of them, each part reading at most its k bits, so it holds at most the best run block plus every product's tile at k plus every gate no tile places; a block reading the update code at c gates

rule: rho = rho_fit where Fit holds, else max(1, the max over the kinds' measured terms); null where no kind is measured. Sensitivities are never in the max.

sensitivities.decoding_form: sensitivity, assumption (D) with A1 (reading B): a block reading the update code runs the whole decoder, so it holds at most max(c - d, min(c, alpha_max (x0 s + s*))) affected gates, x0 and s* from the uncapped profiles; reading B isn't A1's approved reading
sensitivities.per_gate: sensitivity, assumption (A1, reading A) with its witness family, not closed under unions: each gate at the best witness that holds it (per_gate); a block holding one gate of a product beside another product's tile or the best run holds more, for a few bits of that gate's own operands
sensitivities.reduction: sensitivity, assumption (R): each block holding a step's token work passes one partial gradient at its passed width (partial_cut_bits), and the step's token work fills at least ceil(N w / c) blocks; it holds only for partitions split by tokens (a block holding only frozen layers passes no partial)
sensitivities.token_form: sensitivity, assumption (A1, reading B): Slowdown's token form, s* = max_x x(k - u(x))/a and x0 from u_in, u capped at Delta for a block reading the update code; reading B isn't A1's approved reading
sensitivities.update: sensitivity, assumption (U): where two or more blocks hold a step's token work, the block applying the update to a coordinate reads its share of the gradient's cut (grad_cut_bits), the weights read once and theta free; it holds only for partitions split by tokens (a tensor's gradient made and applied in one block breaks it)
